parameters.query:
SELECT
    id,
    company,
    position,
    status,
    interview_date,
    interview_time
FROM job_applications
WHERE status IN ('INTERVIEW', 'INTERVIEW_CONFIRMED')
  AND interview_date IS NOT NULL
  AND interview_time IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      (interview_date + interview_time) > NOW()
  );

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.reminder_type === '24H' ? 'Interview Reminder - Tomorrow' : 'Interview Reminder - In 1 Hour' }}
parameters.message: =Hello,  This is an automatic reminder about your upcoming job interview.  Company: {{ $json.company }} Position: {{ $json.position }} Date: {{ $json.interview_date }} Time: {{ $json.interview_time }}  Reminder: {{ $json.reminder_type }}  Good luck with your interview!  AI Job Application Tracker

parameters.query:
SELECT
    ja.id,
    ja.company,
    ja.position,
    ja.interview_date,
    ja.interview_time,
    $2::VARCHAR AS reminder_type,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM interview_reminders ir
        WHERE ir.application_id = ja.id
          AND ir.reminder_type = $2
    ) AS already_sent
FROM job_applications ja
WHERE ja.id = $1;
